phrases.text: Stocks now live on chain as real-world asset tokens,
RWAs you can hold and borrow against at any hour.
But the stock market behind them still closes
every evening and every weekend.
I'm Aryan, co-founder of StockReef.

segments.question: What breaks when Wall Street closes?
segments.speaker: Aryan

phrases.text: When Nasdaq closes on Friday, Tesla's real price stops until Monday,
but every loan backed by Tesla tokens stays open.
One Monday in sixteen opens five percent or more away from Friday,
so a loan can be underwater before anyone is able to act.
Holders of stock RWAs who want dollars without selling,
and the lenders who fund them.
To stay safe through closures,
lenders keep loans at about half the collateral or less.
I'm Awaan.
StockReef lends up to seventy five percent against stock RWAs,
and cuts the debt before the close while a real price exists.
Then it locks new credit through the closure
and reopens it carefully.

segments.question: Why now, and why Robinhood Chain?
segments.speaker: Awaan

phrases.text: Robinhood Chain is now live on mainnet
with stock RWAs and USDG side by side.
Tokenized stocks have passed three billion dollars,
but lending against these RWAs is still tiny.

segments.question: Why is RWA lending so small, and how do we fix it?
segments.speaker: Awaan

phrases.text: RWA lending stays small because no lender can price the weekend gap.
StockReef turns that gap into rules the contract enforces
before every close, on chain.
So lenders can safely offer up to seventy five percent,
and a stock RWA becomes collateral worth borrowing against.
Lenders earn the borrower's fixed rate,
and StockReef keeps ten percent of that interest.
It also keeps ten percent of each liquidation bonus,
the same shares Aave takes.
Vault USDG can also earn Global Dollar rewards.
We start with Tesla against USDG
and add stock RWAs one market at a time.
Every closure on the exchange calendar,
holidays and early closes included, is already in the contracts.
StockReef runs on Robinhood Chain testnet
with a funded public market and real receipts.
It's backed by five hundred thirty five tests,
including fork tests against the live TSLA token.
Aryan and I built StockReef during this buildathon,
from the contracts to the app.

segments.question: What will we do at Open House Singapore?
segments.speaker: Aryan

phrases.text: At Open House Singapore we'll launch on Robinhood Chain mainnet
with a capped Tesla market and our first lenders.
We'll run a live Friday close with RWA holders in the room,
and tune the thresholds with the Robinhood Chain team.
We need an audit and a market maker for Tesla,
and a Global Dollar partnership for the vault.
StockReef reduces stock-backed debt before the market closes.
